# Beaumont Knights Baseball

> Beaumont Knights Baseball is a 501(c)(3) non-profit youth travel baseball
> club fielding 9U and 10U teams in Beaumont, California (Inland Empire).
> The club is welcoming to first-time travel baseball families as well as
> experienced players, and is run by volunteer parents and coaches.

## Key facts

- Divisions: 9U and 10U
- Location: Beaumont, California
- Registration fee: approximately $300–$450 per season (covers uniform,
  league/field fees, umpires, and insurance)
- Non-profit status: 501(c)(3)
- Instagram: @beaumontknights_92223 (https://instagram.com/beaumontknights_92223)
